incomplete_execution_policy: Publish blind infrastructure-aborted result; do not score partial traces and do not unblind.

invalid_pair_handling.if_evaluable_denominator_below_30: report descriptive counts only; do not apply 15-of-30 interpretation

primary_implementation.input_validation: Exact experiment/revision/model/blinding/trace envelope plus canonical integer observations; booleans are not accepted as integers.
primary_implementation.kappa: Exact integer formula using isqrt from SIGNAL_SCHEMA_FROZEN_SCOPE_REPAIRED.json.
primary_implementation.pair_statistic: Count evaluable pairs where perturbation kappa exceeds control kappa; ties separate.
primary_implementation.source_trace_binding: Each score record binds the exact source trace SHA-256.

secondary_metric.name: delta_hol
secondary_metric.reason: The inherited design names delta_hol as secondary, but the frozen operational trace schema supplies no exact delta_hol transform. No formula is invented after predecessor opaque values were inspected.
